# orq_secret (Resource)

A secret stored in a vault and exposed to factory work items as an environment variable. The value is write-only on the server: it is never read back, so it is kept in Terraform state as configured and a change made outside Terraform is not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "stripe_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "orq_secret" "stripe" {
  vault_id    = orq_vault.staging.id
  name        = "STRIPE_API_KEY"
  kind        = "SECRET"
  value       = var.stripe_api_key
  description = "Stripe test-mode key."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) How the value is exposed: `VARIABLE` (plain configuration, not redacted), `SECRET` (redacted from events, transcripts, commits and pushes) or `SETUP_SECRET` (present only while blueprint setup and maintenance run).
- `name` (String) Environment variable name the work item sees: uppercase letters, digits and underscores, unique within the vault. Names starting with `ORQ_` or `_` are reserved. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value (up to 65536 bytes). Never returned by the API; changing it rotates the stored value.
- `vault_id` (String) Vault that holds the secret. Changing it replaces the secret.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description (up to 2000 characters).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Secret ID assigned by orq.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Secrets are imported as <vault_id>/<secret_id>. Metadata only: the value is
# never returned, so the next apply rotates it to the configured `value`.
terraform import orq_secret.example vault_01K8EXAMPLEVAULT000000000/sec_01K8EXAMPLESECRET000000000
```
